title: Opening Cross receipt attestation, version 1
description: A signed statement that a key saw the receipt of a settled cross with this SHA-256 hash and found it consistent with the cross account (docs/standard/receipt-v1.md, ADR-0941). It has the shape of every signed document in @opening-cross/attest: `id` is the SHA-256 of the canonical body, and `signature` is an Ed25519 signature by `signer` over the schema string, a newline and the id. It attests the hash of the receipt, not that the clearing rule was applied correctly.

cluster.description: The cluster the cross is on, as the receipt's `network` names it.

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical bytes served at /receipt/<cross>/json.

state.description: A receipt is attested only once its cross has settled for good.

statement.description: The standard sentence, carried inside the document so it cannot be quoted without it.

id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `body` (RFC 8785 subset: strings and integers).

signer.description: The key that signed. A reader checks it against the key the operator publishes at /v1/promises/signer.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, lowercase hex, over `opening-cross/receipt-attestation/v1` + LF + `id`.
